subject.title: Feishu: bot does not respond when @-mentioned in a reply message

question: Should maintainers adopt/replace the conflicting cross-repository Feishu candidate, or ask that author to rebase it before any new target-repository fix is queued?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and still present, but an open conflicting cross-repository PR already targets it and the previous same-repository PR was closed unmerged with safety concerns.

options.title: Adopt or replace the candidate
options.body: Use the existing candidate as source context, but land a current-main target-repository fix with bot-specific mention evidence and routing tests.

options.title: Wait for the fork author
options.body: Keep this issue open while asking the cross-repository PR author to rebase and address the previous safety concerns.

options.title: Defer Feishu reply work
options.body: Leave this as a known Feishu channel bug without creating another repair lane until channel ownership bandwidth is available.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace the candidate
recommendation.body: Use the existing candidate as source context, but land a current-main target-repository fix with bot-specific mention evidence and routing tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu mention-handling work makes this the closest routing candidate for the safe mention-detection shape.
